title: Electric field magnitude
description: Essential: The final answer for part (1) is correctly derived as E = m v₀² / (2 q h).

title: Velocity at point a
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) magnitude is correctly derived as v = √2 v₀.

title: Direction at point a
description: Essential: The final answer for part (2) direction is correctly stated as 45° to the positive x-axis.

title: Minimum magnetic field
description: Essential: The final answer for part (3) is correctly derived as B_min = 2 m v₀ / (q L).

title: Kinematics in electric field
description: Important: Correctly applies kinematics (horizontal motion: 2h = v₀t, vertical motion: h = ½ a t²) to relate displacement, time, and acceleration.

title: Force and acceleration relation
description: Important: Correctly relates the electric force to acceleration using Newton's second law: qE = ma.

title: Circular motion geometry
description: Important: Correctly identifies that for minimum B, the particle's circular arc in the magnetic field is tangent to side bc, leading to a radius R = L / √2.

title: Lorentz force as centripetal force
description: Important: Correctly applies the magnetic force law to set qvB = m v² / R for circular motion.

title: Sign or direction error
description: Pitfall: Incorrectly assigns the sign/direction of the electric field, acceleration, or velocity components (e.g., negative for vertical motion in the first quadrant).

title: Unit or formula misuse
description: Pitfall: Misapplies kinematic formulas (e.g., uses v² = u² + 2as incorrectly for horizontal motion) or confuses radius geometry.
